name: Do I need an electrician for a custom media wall project?

mainEntity.name: Do I need an electrician for a custom media wall project?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, an electrician is often needed for custom media wall projects, especially if new outlets, cable management solutions, or integrated lighting are being installed. Ensuring proper power supply and safe wiring is crucial for media components. A key preparation step is to map out all existing outlets and desired new electrical points to ensure all media equipment can be powered and connected safely and aesthetically.
acceptedAnswer.description: An electrician is usually needed for new outlets, cable management, or integrated lighting in a custom media wall.
